whoWeAre: Obaatanpa Foundation is a community-based non-profit organisation founded in the Wassa Amenfi East Municipality, with a deep commitment to empowering women and the girl child. The name Obaatanpa means “Good Mother” in Akan, and it carries our core belief: when you empower a mother, you empower a whole generation.
vision: A society where no woman or girl is left behind — where mothers, adolescent girls, the aged, and persons with disabilities live empowered lives in an all-inclusive Wassa Amenfi East.
mission: Obaatanpa Foundation exists to uplift vulnerable groups through compassionate outreach, provision of sanitary materials, food, medical care, tools and equipment, and sustained advocacy for gender responsiveness, equity and equality.

values.name: Compassion
values.body: Just like an Obaatanpa, we care for all.

values.name: Empowerment
values.body: We give tools, not just handouts and lip service.

values.name: Equity
values.body: Fairness for all genders and capabilities.

problem: Many women, adolescent girls, the aged and persons with disabilities in this municipality lack access to basic sanitary materials, healthcare, economic tools, and information about their rights. The consequences compound: girls drop out of school, health deteriorates, households stay economically dependent, and gender inequality persists into the next generation.
whoWeServe: Mothers, adolescent girls and boys in schools, the aged, persons with disabilities, and the general populace of Wassa Amenfi East and beyond.
objectives: To empower women and girls through education, skills and livelihood support.
To provide sanitary materials, food, medical care and basic necessities to vulnerable groups.
To support the aged and persons with disabilities with essential tools and welfare services.
To conduct outreach programmes in schools to mentor adolescent girls and boys.
To advocate for gender equality, equity and gender responsiveness in communities.
To promote the welfare and inclusion of all vulnerable persons in society.
goal: To build an inclusive society where every woman and girl child in Wassa Amenfi East thrives with dignity, equality and opportunity.
target: 5,000+ women, girls and vulnerable persons over the next five years.
promise: At Obaatanpa Foundation we do not just give handouts. We nurture strength and empower futures, and we believe in an all-inclusive society where no one is left behind.
